caption: The shipped 'Logic Gate AND 4-bit' example (issue #1265): four AND-from-NAND slices AND0–AND3 side by side — inputs A0–A3 and B0–B3, outputs Y0–Y3, the ISA AND datapath. No wires join the slices; the operand bits arrive through persisted signal names.

Close-up of slice AND0: the shipped 'Logic Gate AND-from-NAND' gate (NAND stage feeding a second inverter stage with its own bias, threshold 0.25) — A0 and B0 in, Y0 out; the slices stand clear of each other — the DesignValidator reports no overlaps.
